desc:
🌱 1,000,000 blades of grass. One little trimmer. Can you and your friends cut it down to zero?

👥 Mow with friends. Invite a friend into your half-finished yard or offer to help with theirs. Split the field, earn 2× Cash while you mow together, and see who cut the most. Finish a Crew Mow round and vote on the next lawn.

🚜 Build your dream mower. Cut your first stripe with a blade trimmer, then work your way up to a zero-turn mower. Spend the Cash you earn on a wider cut, faster mowing, or more Cash per cut.

🎡 Explore 10 miniature worlds. Stripe the outfield at Alder Creek Ballpark, weave between the apple trees at Cider Mill Orchard, or mow beneath the Ferris wheel at Lantern County Fair.

🏡 Make it your own solo challenge. Pick a lawn, mow at your own pace, and come back to the exact patch where you left off. That last blade is yours.
